inputs.label: Mario Kart 64 ROM (US)
inputs.help: Your own US Mario Kart 64 ROM as .z64, .n64 or .v64 (12 MiB).

steps.text: Open XRKart 64 from Library > Unknown Sources. Choose Select legally dumped ROM, pick your ROM and wait for the check. Then choose Generate local game data. This takes several minutes: keep the app open and the headset awake. The game starts by itself when it is done.

notes: The guide gives a normalized SHA-1 (579C48E211AE952530FFC8738709F078D5DD215E), which equals the file hash only for a .z64 (big-endian) ROM. It is not in sha1 because that would reject .n64 and .v64 files; QGPUI could check it after byte-order normalization.
